_comment: Single source of truth for every payment surface on this site. Read by src/data/support.ts (web) and scripts/generate-payment-qr.py (QR codes). Change recipientAddress here and re-run `npm run qr` - nothing else needs editing. recipientAddress is a Shakepay custodial deposit address on Base; confirm it still matches the Base tab in the Shakepay app before each redeploy.
